description: Counts code the way pre.dev's public script does (code files in full, text files up to 10x the code, minified and bundle-named files skipped, 4 bytes per token) and prices it at Pangea's published non-exclusive list rates per million tokens of source and of git history. Give files (path and size in bytes, e.g. from `git ls-tree -r -l HEAD`), or code_bytes and text_bytes, or source_tokens. History is optional. A list price, not an offer.

code_bytes.description: Bytes of code files, if you summed them yourself.

files.description: Files at HEAD, paths relative to the repo root. Skip rules (node_modules, vendor, build output) are applied here.

text_bytes.description: Bytes of text files (Markdown, JSON, YAML, HTML).

name: code_value
title: Price private code at a buyer's published per-token rates
